_README: EVERY user-facing string in the product lives in this file. If you are adding text a person will read, add a key here and reference it — do not write it into a component. This file is also the answer to 'where does that word come from?', which is otherwise hard: strings assembled by code are invisible to search. TRAPS THAT HAVE ACTUALLY BITTEN, each more than once: (1) getTranslations() without a locale renders English inside an otherwise translated page — always pass { locale: params.locale, namespace }, adding params to the page signature if absent; not-found.tsx is the sole exception, since Next passes it no params, so it reads getLocale(). (2) Module-level constants (STEPS, TYPES, STATUS_STYLES, TABS) are evaluated at import where no translator exists — store labelKey and resolve at render. (3) Module-level FUNCTIONS have the same problem and cannot use hooks either; pass the translator in as an argument (see timeAgo in NotificationCenter). (4) Helpers that return finished English prose cannot be translated by their caller — return a key plus its values instead (see getDepositCopy and AllowanceReason). (5) A map or callback parameter named `t` silently shadows the translator. (6) Raw Prisma enums rendered with .toLowerCase() or .replace(/_/g,' ') stay English — use getEnumLabeller and add the values under `enum`. (7) Dates: toLocaleDateString('en-RW') pins dates to English; use lib/dates.ts, which carries real month names for all four locales. Also watch for ternaries, pluralising conditionals, and title-case text rendered uppercase by CSS — grepping the visible text finds none of them. Locale files other than en.json may be partial; missing keys fall back to English per key, which is why English must stay complete.

about.metaDescription: Impamvu ZuriDrive ibaho n'uko dufata imodoka n'amafaranga y'abandi.
about.title: Ibyerekeye ZuriDrive
about.intro: Gukodesha imodoka mu Rwanda bigomba koroha nko gufata icyumba muri hoteri. Kandi bikaba bifite umutekano ku utanga urufunguzo.
about.problemP1: Mu Rwanda hari imodoka nyinshi zicaye ubusa. Hari n'abantu benshi bazikeneye ku mpera z'icyumweru, mu rugendo rw'akazi cyangwa ukwezi kose. Icyabuze ni uburyo bwo guhuza impande zombi aho zombi ziyumva zifite umutekano.
about.problemP2: Nyir'imodoka utanga imodoka ye ahangayikishwa n'uko yakwangirika, n'uwo ari we uyitwara koko, no kuzahembwa. Umukodesha we ahangayikishwa no kwishyuzwa birenze, n'imodoka itameze nk'uko amafoto yabyerekanaga, n'ingwate itagaruka. ZuriDrive ibaho kugira ngo izo mpungenge zombi zibe iby'ubusa.
about.trustIntro: Aya ni yo mahame urubuga rwubatsweho koko.
about.trust1: Ingwate si amafaranga yacu. Ibikwa ukwayo itandukanye n'amafaranga y'ubukode, nta na kimwe tuyikuraho, kandi buri kuyimura kwandikwa. Isubira ku mukode keretse hari ibimenyetso bishyigikira ikirego.
about.trust2: Inyandiko z'imari zongerwaho gusa. Iyo hari ikitagenze neza tugikosora twandika inyandiko nshya, ntitwigeze duhindura iya kera mu ibanga. Ibitabo bigereranywa n'ibipimo bibiri by'imibare bigomba guhora bihuye.
about.trust3: Ibimenyetso biruta ibitekerezo. Impande zombi zifotora imodoka mbere na nyuma. Iyo hari impaka, dufata icyemezo dushingiye ku byo amafoto n'amasaha byerekana, atari ku uvuga cyane.
about.trust4: Nta wungukira ku guhemukira undi. Umukodesha uhagarika ku munota wa nyuma yishyura nyir'imodoka. Nyir'imodoka uhagaritse nta cyo yigumanira na rimwe.
about.trust5: Ubukode bwamaze kwishyurwa burarindwa. Niba gahunda ya nyir'imodoka irangiye, imodoka zifite ingendo ziri imbere zikomeza kugaragara. Ntituzareka umukodesha ngo asigare hanze kubera ikibazo cy'ubwishyu kitamureba.
about.paysP1: Kwinjira bikorwa hakoreshejwe nimero ya telefoni na kode ya SMS, kuko ari byo buri wese afite. Kwishyura bikorwa kuri MTN Mobile Money cyangwa banki hamwe n'icyemezo, kuko ari ko amafaranga agenda hano. Ibiciro biri mu mafaranga y'u Rwanda kandi bibarwa mu mibare yuzuye. Nta gukosora imibare gutwara inyungu z'undi mu ibanga.

cookies.metaDescription: Ama cookie make ZuriDrive ikoresha, n'impamvu.
cookies.title: Amabwiriza ku ma cookie
cookies.intro: Dukoresha make cyane. Nta na rimwe rigukurikirana.
cookies.shortP1: ZuriDrive nta ma cookie yo kwamamaza cyangwa ayo gusesengura ishyiraho. Ntabwo dushyiramo Google Analytics, Meta Pixel cyangwa ikindi gikurikirana nk'ibyo. Nta kabari ko kwemera kari kuri uru rubuga kuko nta cyo kwemera. Ama cookie yonyine dushyiraho ni ayakenewe kugira ngo ukomeze kuba winjiye.
cookies.ddSession: Ituma ukomeza kuba winjiye uko wimuka ku mapaji. Idahari wagombye kongera kwandika kode yawe kuri buri rupapuro. Ikurwaho iyo usohotse.
cookies.ddSecurity: Agaciro k'igihe gito katuma tugenzura ko ifishi yoherejwe ivuye ku rubuga rwacu, ari na ko tubuza izindi mbuga gukora mu izina ryawe utabizi.
cookies.ddReturn: Yibuka urupapuro wari ugana igihe wasabwaga kwinjira, kugira ngo tuzagusubizeyo nyuma.
cookies.setP1: Yose uko ari atatu ni ngombwa rwose: urubuga ntirwakora atariho, kandi mu mategeko y'u Rwanda n'andi asa na yo ntabwo asaba uruhushya rwo kwemera.
cookies.thirdP1: Amafoto atangwa na Cloudinary naho ubwishyu bwemezwa kuri sisitemu za MTN. Abo batanga serivisi bashobora gushyiraho ama cookie yabo ku mbuga zabo igihe mushakisha wawe ufata ifoto cyangwa urangiza ubwishyu. Ntabwo tuyagenzura kandi ntitwayasoma.
cookies.offP1: Mushakisha wawe ashobora guhagarika ama cookie, ariko guhagarika ayacu bivuze ko utazashobora kwinjira. Bikaba bidashoboka gukodesha imodoka cyangwa gucunga iyawe yanditse.

help.metaDescription: Ibisubizo ku ngwate, guhagarika, kwishyurwa n'impaka kuri ZuriDrive.
help.title: Ahatangirwa ubufasha
help.intro: Ibibazo abantu babaza koko, bisubijwe mu buryo bwumvikana.
help.a1: Ipfukirana kwangirika, lisansi ibuze cyangwa kugarura bitinze. Ntabwo iri mu giciro cy'ubukode kandi nta na kimwe tuyikuraho.
help.a2: Nyuma y'uko urugendo rurangiye kandi impande zombi zemeje ko imodoka yagaruwe. Nta muntu utanze ikibazo, isubizwa yose.
help.q3: Nyir'imodoka arasaba ku ngwate yanjye. None bite?
help.a3: Agomba kwerekana ibimenyetso. Ushobora gufungura impaka, ukongeraho amafoto yawe n'ibisobanuro, maze umuntu agafata icyemezo. Amafoto wafashe mbere y'urugendo ni yo akunda gukemura ikibazo. Ni yo mpamvu kuyafata ari ingenzi.
help.a4: Oya. Isubira kuri wowe, cyangwa igahabwa nyir'imodoka nk'indishyi nyuma y'ikirego gifite ishingiro cyangwa guhagarika bitinze. Ntabwo na rimwe iba inyungu zacu.
help.a5: Uhagaritse mbere y'igihe ntarengwa. Ubu ni amasaha 24 mbere yo gufata imodoka. Usubizwa byose, ubukode n'ingwate. Uhagaritse igihe kirenze, nyir'imodoka agumana igice cy'ingwate, ubu ni 50%. Amafaranga y'ubukode ahora agusubizwa yose.
help.a6: Nyir'imodoka yanze ubundi bukode kuri izo tariki. Guhagarika ijoro ribanziriza bikunze gusobanura ko imodoka nta cyo yinjiza kuri iyo mpera y'icyumweru.
help.q7: Ntekereza ko ayo mafaranga atari yo.
help.a7: Ayaregere uhereye ku rupapuro rw'ubukode. Tanga impamvu wongereho ibimenyetso. Ubutumwa bwa nyir'imodoka, icyemezo cya muganga, icyo ari cyo cyose kigushyigikira. Nidusanga ufite ukuri, ingwate yose irasubizwa.
help.a8: Usubizwa byose kandi we nta cyo agumana. Ibyo ni ko bimeze igihe cyose ahagaritse.
help.a9: Turagushishikariza cyane kuyafata. Ni byo bimenyetso dukoresha mu mpaka. Utagize ayawe bwite, uba wiringiye ay'urundi ruhande.
help.a10: Asibwa mu buryo bwikora iminsi mike nyuma y'uko urugendo rurangiye. Ubu ni itatu. Amafoto ari ku mpaka zifunguye abikwa kugeza zikemutse.
help.a11: MTN Mobile Money, cyangwa kwohereza kuri banki hamwe n'icyemezo cy'ubwishyu. Kuri MoMo wemeza ubutumwa buza kuri telefoni yawe. Ku bwa banki, abashinzwe imari barabwemeza, akenshi mu masaha make.
help.q12: Amafaranga yavuye kuri konti yanjye ariko ubukode ntibwemejwe.
help.a12post: utanga nimero y'ubukode bwawe na nimero y'ubwishyu bwa MoMo, tuzabigereranya.
help.q13: Gusubizwa amafaranga bitwara igihe kingana iki?
help.a14: Ifata ku bukode. Ubu ni 20%. Nta na kimwe ku ngwate. Ijanisha rifatwa igihe ubukode bukorwa, bityo impinduka yaje nyuma ntihindura ubukode wamaze kwakira.
help.a15: Inyungu ziba zishobora kwishyurwa iyo urugendo rurangiye kandi kugarura imodoka byemejwe. Usaba kwishyurwa uhereye ku ncamake yawe maze tukabyohereza kuri nimero ya MoMo cyangwa konti ya banki iri mu mwirondoro wawe.
help.q16: Bigenda bite gahunda yanjye iramutse irangiye?
help.a16: Imodoka zirenze umubare w'ubuntu zirahishwa, kandi utakaza kugaragara mbere n'ikimenyetso cyo kwemezwa. Imodoka zifite ubukode bukora cyangwa buri imbere zikomeza kugaragara. Ntituzasiga hanze umuntu wamaze kwishyura. Kongera gufata gahunda bigarura neza imodoka twahishe, kandi bigasiga iyo wowe ubwawe wahagaritse ihagaritswe.
help.q17: Ndatakaza iminsi niyongera gufata hakiri kare?
help.a17: Oya. Kongera gufata byongeraho igihe cyuzuye hejuru y'igisigaye, bityo kongera gufata hakiri kare nta cyo bikugusaba.
help.a18: Tugamije gusubiza mu masaha 24, cyangwa amasaha 4 kuri Premium. Umurongo utondekanywa hakurikijwe ikibazo cyegereye kurenza igihe cyacyo, bityo ikibazo gisanzwe kimaze igihe kirekire ntikigumye inyuma y'ibindi bishya byihutirwa.
help.stuckPre: Ba nyir'imodoka bashobora gufungura ikibazo bahereye
help.stuckPost: Kandi niba urugendo rurimo gukorwa hakaba hari ikitagenze, hamagara aho kwandika imeyili.

privacy.metaDescription: Uko ZuriDrive ikusanya, ikoresha kandi irinda amakuru yawe bwite mu Rwanda.
privacy.title: Amabwiriza ku ibanga
privacy.intro: Ibyo dukusanya, impamvu tubikusanya, n'ibyo ushobora kudusaba kubikora.
privacy.s1p1: ZuriDrive ni urubuga rwo gukodesha imodoka rukorera mu Rwanda. Duhuza abashaka gukodesha imodoka na ba nyirazo. Ubu abakodesha bishyura ba nyir'imodoka bo ubwabo igihe bakiriye imodoka. ZuriDrive ntabwo yakira amafaranga y'ubukode cyangwa ngo ibike ingwate.
privacy.s1p2: Ku birebana n'Itegeko No 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite, ZuriDrive ni yo igenzura amakuru avuzwe hano. Ushobora kutugeraho kuri .
privacy.s2intro: Dukusanya gusa ibyo gukodesha bisaba koko.
privacy.s2dd1: Nimero ya telefoni yawe (ni yo winjiza), kandi ushobora kongeraho amazina, imeyili n'ifoto y'umwirondoro.
privacy.s2dd2: Ntabwo tugusaba cyangwa ngo tubike nimero y'indangamuntu yawe, nimero y'uruhushya rwo gutwara, cyangwa ifoto y'urumwe muri byo. Wemeza igihe urangiza ubukode ko ufite uruhushya rwemewe, kandi nyir'imodoka akagenzura impapuro zawe imbonankubone mbere yo kuguha imodoka. Twandika gusa ko igenzura ryabaye n'icyo nyirayo yasanze. Ntabwo twandika impapuro ubwazo. Kuzibika byadutuma tuba intego yo kwibasirwa, kandi nta cyo byahamya: ifoto yashyizweho nta cyo ivuga ku uzagaragara koko.
privacy.s2dd3: Nimero yawe ya MTN MoMo, cyangwa izina rya banki, izina rya konti na nimero ya konti. Bikoreshwa gusa mu kuguha ibyo winjije.
privacy.s2dd4: Amatariki, aho bafata n'aho basubiza imodoka, igiciro cyumvikanyweho, n'aho urugendo rugeze.
privacy.s2dd5: Amafoto impande zombi zifata ku ntangiriro no ku musozo w'urugendo. Ariho kugira ngo akemure impaka ku byangiritse kandi asibwa mu buryo bwikora. Reba igika cya 5.
privacy.s2dd6: Ubu ZuriDrive ntabwo yakira ubwishyu bw'ubukode. Wishyura nyir'imodoka we ubwe igihe akira imodoka, bityo nta nyandiko dufite y'ubwo bwishyu uretse ibyo ubukode ubwabwo bwavuze ko byumvikanyweho. Ba nyir'imodoka batwishyura gahunda y'ukwezi, kuri iyo tubika umubare, uburyo n'inomero. Ntitwigeze tubona PIN cyangwa amakuru yuzuye y'ikarita.
privacy.s2dd7: Ibibazo by'ubufasha ufungura, dosiye zose wometse, n'igitabo cy'ubutumwa bwa SMS tukwoherereza (uwo bwagenewe, ibirimo n'uko bwakiriwe) kugira ngo dushobore kwerekana ibyoherejwe no gukurikirana ibyanze.
privacy.s2dd8: Amanota n'ibitekerezo byanditse utanga nyuma y'urugendo.
privacy.s2end: Ntabwo dukurikirana aho uri mu buryo buhishe, kandi ntitugura amakuru bwite ku bandi.
privacy.s3li1: Gukora ubukode. Kuguhuza n'imodoka, kwemeza ubwishyu, no kubwira impande zombi ibiri kubaho.
privacy.s3li2: Kwandika ko umwirondoro wagenzuwe. Kugira ngo hagire ibimenyetso ko nyir'imodoka yabonye uruhushya mbere yo gutanga imodoka ye, tutabitse impapuro.
privacy.s3li3: Gukemura impaka. Amafoto y'uko imodoka yari imeze n'inyandiko z'urugendo ni byo bimenyetso dukoresha iyo impande zitumvikanye ku byangiritse, lisansi cyangwa gutinda.
privacy.s3li4: Kwishyuza ba nyir'imodoka gahunda yabo. Gahunda ibemerera kwandikisha imodoka.
privacy.s3li5: Kubahiriza inshingano z'amategeko n'imisoro. Inyandiko z'imari zibikwa nk'uko amategeko y'u Rwanda abisaba.
privacy.s3end: Ntitugurisha amakuru yawe bwite, kandi ntabwo tuyakoresha mu kubaka imyirondoro yo kwamamaza.
privacy.s4intro: Ibyangombwa gusa, kandi ku bantu babikeneye kugira ngo serivisi ikore:
privacy.s4li1: Urundi ruhande mu bukode bwawe. Nyir'imodoka abona amazina na nimero ya telefoni y'umukodesha ku rugendo rwemejwe, kandi akagenzura impapuro ze imbonankubone igihe amuha imodoka. Umukodesha abona amazina na nimero ya telefoni ya nyir'imodoka. Nta n'umwe ubona aho undi yishyurirwa.
privacy.s4li2: Utanga serivisi z'ubwishyu. Igihe ZuriDrive izatangira kwakira amafaranga y'ubukode. Ubu ntabwo ibikora, kandi nta makuru y'ubwishyu ava kuri twe kuko nta yakusanyijwe.
privacy.s4li3: Africa's Talking. Kohereza SMS, aho SMS yashyizweho. Kwinjira bikoresha ijambobanga, bityo konti nyinshi ntizigera zitera ubutumwa na buke.
privacy.s4li5: Inzego z'u Rwanda. Aho amategeko adusaba kubitangaza, cyangwa aho bikenewe mu gukurikirana icyaha nko kwiba imodoka.
privacy.s4end: Bamwe muri abo batanga serivisi bacunga amakuru hanze y'u Rwanda. Aho bibaye, twiringira amasezerano yabo yo kurinda amakuru.
privacy.s5li1: Amafoto y'uko imodoka imeze asibwa mu buryo bwikora iminsi mike nyuma y'uko urugendo rurangiye. Igihe nyacyo gishyirwa mu igenamiterere ry'urubuga kandi ubu ni iminsi itatu. Amafoto ari ku mpaka zifunguye abikwa kugeza impaka zikemutse.
privacy.s5li2: Inyandiko z'imari. Ubwishyu bwa gahunda za ba nyir'imodoka, n'ubwishyu bw'ubukode nitumara gutangira kubwakira. Bibikwa igihe cyose amategeko y'imisoro n'ibaruramari abisaba. Izi nyandiko zongerwaho gusa: dukosora ikosa twandika inyandiko nshya, ntitwigera duhindura cyangwa gusiba iya kera.
privacy.s5li3: Konti yawe ibikwa igihe cyose ifunguye. Nuyifunga dukuraho umwirondoro wawe, ariko tugumana inyandiko z'imari n'iz'ingendo zifitanye isano n'ubukode bwarangiye, kuko urundi ruhande rwo muri izo ngendo rufite inyungu zifatika muri zo kandi natwe dufite inshingano z'amategeko.
privacy.s5li4: Igitabo cya SMS kibikwa kugira ngo dukemure ibibazo kandi kibe ikimenyetso mu mpaka.
privacy.s6intro: Mu mategeko y'u Rwanda arinda amakuru bwite ushobora kudusaba:
privacy.s6li1: kukubwira amakuru dufite kuri wowe, no kuguha kopi;
privacy.s6li3: gusiba amakuru yawe, aho tudasabwa kuyabika ku mpamvu z'amategeko cyangwa iz'ibaruramari;
privacy.s6li5: gutanga ikirego mu Rwego rw'Igihugu rw'Umutekano w'Ikoranabuhanga niba utekereza ko twayafashe nabi.
privacy.s6end: Andikira <mail></mail> maze tuzagusubiza mu minsi 30. Dushobora kubanza kugusaba kwemeza umwirondoro wawe. Ntabwo tuzaha inyandiko zawe umuntu uvuga gusa ko ari wowe.
privacy.s7p1: Amagambobanga, aho wayashyizeho, ahindurwa mu buryo budasubirwaho kandi ntabikwe mu buryo busomeka. Kode zo kwinjira zirangira kandi zigahagarikwa nyuma yo kugerageza inshuro nyinshi bikanga. Kugera ku bikoresho by'ubuyobozi bigenwa n'uruhare, kandi ibikorwa byihariye byandikwa mu gitabo cy'igenzura cyerekana uwakoze iki na ryari.
privacy.s7p2: Nta sisitemu ifite umutekano wuzuye. Niba amakuru yawe bwite yagizweho ingaruka n'icyuho, tuzakumenyesha kandi tumenyeshe n'urwego rubifitiye ububasha nk'uko amategeko abisaba.
privacy.s8pre: Dukoresha ama cookie make cyane ari ngombwa. Ahanini kugira ngo ukomeze kuba winjiye. Reba
privacy.s9p1: Nituvugurura aya mabwiriza tuzahindura itariki iri hejuru, kandi ku bintu bikomeye tuzabikubwira ubwacu. Gukomeza gukoresha ZuriDrive nyuma y'impinduka bisobanura ko wemeye amabwiriza mashya.

terms.metaDescription: Amasezerano hagati yawe, ZuriDrive, n'urundi ruhande mu bukode bwawe.
terms.title: Amasezerano ya serivisi
terms.intro: Ibyo wemera igihe ukodesha imodoka, cyangwa uyandikisha, kuri ZuriDrive.
terms.s1p1: ZuriDrive ni urubuga rw'ubucuruzi. Duhuza abashaka gukodesha imodoka na ba nyirazo.
terms.s1p2: Ubu ntabwo twakira amafaranga cyangwa ngo tubike ingwate. Umukodesha yishyura nyir'imodoka we ubwe igihe akira imodoka, ku mabwiriza bumvikanyeho bombi. Inyungu zacu ziva muri gahunda ba nyir'imodoka batwishyura kugira ngo bandike imodoka zabo. Ibika cya 4 n'icya 5 bisobanura uko ubwishyu n'amafaranga yo guhagarika bizakora nitumara gutangira kubyakira; kugeza icyo gihe ibyo ni ibyanyu n'urundi ruhande.
terms.s1p3: Ntabwo dufite imodoka zanditse hano kandi si twe tuzigukodesha. Amasezerano y'ubukode ari hagati y'umukodesha na nyir'imodoka. Icyo dushinzwe ni ugucunga urubuga mu bunyangamugayo: gusobanura imodoka uko ziri, gukurikiza aya masezerano kimwe ku bose, no gucira imanza z'impaka mu bwisanzure dushingiye ku bimenyetso.
terms.s2p1: Ugomba kuba ufite imyaka 18 cyangwa irenga. Kugira ngo ukodeshe ukeneye uruhushya rwo gutwara rwemewe n'indangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo. Ntabwo tugusaba kubishyiraho. Wemeza igihe urangiza ubukode ko ubifite, kandi nyir'imodoka akabigenzura imbonankubone mbere yo kuguha imodoka. Kuza utabifite ni impamvu ituma nyirayo akwima imodoka. Kugira ngo wandike imodoka ugomba kuba uri nyirayo mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko cyangwa ufite uburenganzira bwanditse bwa nyirayo.
terms.s2p2: Uri wowe ushinzwe ibiba kuri konti yawe. Gumana ijambobanga ryawe.
terms.s3p1: Ubukode bwemezwa igihe nyir'imodoka abwakiriye. Kugeza icyo gihe imodoka ntabwo iba ibitswe kuri wowe. Ubwishyu bwumvikanwaho na nyir'imodoka we ubwe. Mwumvikane uko na ryari mbere yo kugenda gufata imodoka.
terms.s3p2: Niba nyir'imodoka atagize icyo asubiza mu gihe cyagenwe, ubukode bwemezwa mu buryo bwikora kugira ngo utagumye utegereje ubuziraherezo. Niba nyir'imodoka abwanze, nta cyo urimo.
terms.s4p1: Nta na kimwe muri ibi kirakoreshwa. Uyu munsi wishyura nyir'imodoka we ubwe. Bisobanura uburyo buzatangira gukoreshwa igihe ZuriDrive izatangira kwakira amafaranga, kandi tuzabikubwira mbere y'uko bibaho.
terms.s4p2: Amafaranga y'ubukode. Yerekanwa yose mbere y'uko wishyura. ZuriDrive ifataho igice. Ubu ni 20%. Ibisigaye bikajya kuri nyir'imodoka. Ijanisha rireba ubukode bwawe rifatwa igihe ukodesha; impinduka yaje nyuma ntihindura ubukode bwamaze gukorwa.
terms.s4p3: Ingwate. Ibikwa ukwayo itandukanye n'amafaranga y'ubukode. Ntabwo ari inyungu, nta na kimwe tuyikuraho, kandi igusubizwa keretse hari ikirego gifite ishingiro kuri yo. Buri kuyimura kwandikwa.
terms.s4p4: Gusubizwa amafaranga bikorwa unyuze mu buryo wakoresheje wishyura, ubusanzwe mu minsi 1–3 y'akazi iyo tumaze kubyemeza.
terms.s5p1: Igihe cyose ubwishyu bukorwa hagati yanyu, amabwiriza yo guhagarika ni ayanyu n'urundi ruhande. Amategeko ari hasi azatangira gukurikizwa igihe ZuriDrive izatangira kubika ingwate.
terms.s5p2: Uhagaritse hakiri kare nta cyo wishyura. Niba uhagaritse mbere y'igihe ntarengwa, amafaranga y'ubukode n'ingwate yawe yose birasubizwa.
terms.s5p3: Uhagaritse bitinze hariho amafaranga. Niba uhagaritse igihe ntarengwa kitarangira mbere yo gufata imodoka. Ubu ni amasaha 24. Dufata igice cy'ingwate yawe, ubu ni 50%, tukagiha nyir'imodoka. Yanze ubundi bukode kuri izo tariki. Amafaranga y'ubukode bwawe ahora agusubizwa yose; ayo mafaranga akurwa ku ngwate gusa.
terms.s5p4: Niba nyir'imodoka ahagaritse, nta cyo agumana, igihe cyose abikoze. Usubizwa byose. Nyir'imodoka ntagomba na rimwe kungukira ku guhagarika.
terms.s5p5: Ushobora kuregera amafaranga yo guhagarika. Niba utekereza ko atari yo. Nyir'imodoka ni we wagusunikiye guhagarika, imodoka ntiyabonetse, hari impanuka. Ushobora kubirwanya utanga impamvu n'ibimenyetso, maze umuntu akabisuzuma. Nidusanga ufite ukuri, ingwate yose irasubizwa.
terms.s6p1: Fotora imodoka mbere yo kuyitwara na nyuma yo kuyigarura. Impande zombi zibikora. Ayo mafoto ni ibimenyetso dukoresha iyo hari impaka ku byangiritse, kandi asibwa iminsi mike nyuma y'uko urugendo rurangiye. Nutayafata, uba wiringiye ay'urundi ruhande gusa.
terms.s6p2: Garura imodoka ku gihe, imeze uko wayakiriye, ifite lisansi imodoka isaba. Uri wowe ushinzwe amande y'umuhanda, amafaranga y'inzira n'ibihano byatanzwe mu gihe imodoka iri kuri wowe.
terms.s6p3: Ntukodeshe imodoka undi muntu, ntuyikoreshe mu byaha, ntuyitware unywe ibisindisha, kandi ntuyijyane hanze y'u Rwanda utabifitiye uruhushya rwanditse rwa nyirayo.
terms.s7p1: Niba nyir'imodoka aregera ingwate, agomba gutanga ibimenyetso. Uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose rushobora gufungura impaka, maze tugafata icyemezo dushingiye ku byo tubona: amafoto y'uko imodoka yari imeze, amasaha, ubutumwa n'inyandiko z'urugendo.
terms.s7p2: Icyemezo cyacu kigena ibiba ku ngwate. Ntibibuza uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose gukurikirana ikibazo mu nkiko z'u Rwanda, kandi ntabwo ari cyo gisimbura ubwishingizi.
terms.s8p1: Imodoka yawe igomba kuba ikwiye kugenda mu muhanda, yanditse mu buryo bwemewe n'amategeko kandi ifite ubwishingizi bujyanye n'icyo ikodeshwa. Ibyanditswe bigomba kuba ari ukuri. Amafoto agomba kuba ari ay'imodoka nyayo.
terms.s8p2: Gahunda z'ukwezi. Gahunda zishyurwa iminsi 30 icyarimwe kandi ntabwo zisubira ubwazo zigafata amafaranga yawe utabizi; wowe wongera ubishaka. Kongera gufata hakiri kare byongeraho igihe cyuzuye hejuru y'iminsi usigaje, bityo nta cyo ubitakariza. Niba gahunda irangiye, imodoka zirenze umubare wawe w'ubuntu zirahishwa. Ariko imodoka iyo ari yo yose ifite ubukode bukora cyangwa buri imbere ikomeza kugaragara, kuko hari uwishyuye urwo rugendo. Kongera gufata bigarura neza imodoka twahishe.
terms.s8p3: Kwishyurwa. Inyungu zawe ziba zishobora kwishyurwa iyo urugendo rurangiye. Gumana amakuru yawe yo kwishyurwa ari ukuri. Ntitwishingira amafaranga yoherejwe kuri nimero itari yo watanze.
terms.s9p1: Turi urubuga rw'ubucuruzi, kandi tuvuga ukuri ku mbibi zabyo. Ntitwishingira imimerere ya tekiniki y'imodoka, imyitwarire ya nyir'imodoka cyangwa umukodesha, impanuka, gukomereka, ubujura, cyangwa igihombo giturutse ku rugendo ubwarwo. Ibyo bireba impande z'ubukode n'abishingizi babo.
terms.s9p2: Turashinzwe gufata amafaranga yawe neza, kubika inyandiko nyazo, no gukurikiza aya masezerano kimwe ku bose. Nta na kimwe hano kigabanya inshingano amategeko y'u Rwanda atatwemerera kugabanya.
terms.s10p1: Dushobora guhagarika cyangwa gukuraho konti ku mpamvu z'uburiganya, guhagarika kenshi, imyitwarire idafite umutekano, kwandika ibinyoma, cyangwa guhohotera undi mukoresha. Aho tubikoze, amafaranga usanzwe ugomba akomeza kwishyurwa. Guhagarikwa si uburyo bwo kukugumanira inyungu zawe.
terms.s11p1: Aya masezerano agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda, kandi inkiko z'u Rwanda ni zo zifite ububasha ku mpaka zose zaturuka kuri yo.

howItWorks.heroTitle: Ibyo ugomba kumenya byose kuri ZuriDrive
howItWorks.heroSub: Waba ukodesha imodoka cyangwa uyandikisha, twubatse ZuriDrive kugira ngo bibe binyuze mu mucyo, bifite umutekano kandi byoroshye.
howItWorks.r1Body: Shakisha imodoka ukurikije aho uzayifatira, amatariki, n'ubwoko bw'ubukode (ku munsi, ku cyumweru cyangwa ku kwezi). Shungura ukurikije icyiciro cy'imodoka, uburyo bwo guhindura vitesi, urwego rw'ibiciro, n'aho ukeneye umushoferi. Imodoka zerekanwe by'umwihariko n'izemejwe ziza mbere.
howItWorks.r2Body: Buri modoka yerekana ibiciro byose birambuye. Ku munsi mu mujyi, hanze y'umujyi, ku cyumweru no ku kwezi. Uzabona amabwiriza ya lisansi, ingwate, ahantu bafata imodoka, n'ikimenyetso cy'igihe nyirayo amara asubiza.
howItWorks.r3Body: Abasanzwe baza basanga amakuru yabo yuzuye. Abaza bwa mbere bandika amazina na nimero ya telefoni bagahitamo ijambobanga. Konti yawe ifungurwa mu gihe ukodesha. Nta ntambwe yihariye yo kwiyandikisha.
howItWorks.r4Body: Hitamo MTN Mobile Money (ubutumwa bwa USSD buza kuri telefoni yawe) cyangwa kwohereza kuri banki (ushyireho icyemezo, abashinzwe imari bakabyemeza). Ubukode bwawe bwemezwa gusa iyo ubwishyu bwakiriwe burundu. Ntabwo bwemezwa gusa kubera ko bwatangijwe.
howItWorks.r5Body: Nyir'imodoka yemeza mu masaha 2 (cyangwa bikemezwa mu buryo bwikora). Mwembi mushyiraho amafoto y'uko imodoka imeze mbere y'urugendo, harimo n'igipimo cya lisansi. Garura imodoka, ushyireho amafoto yo nyuma, maze ingwate yawe igasubizwa mu buryo bwikora.
howItWorks.depositCardIntro: Ingwate y'ibyangiritse itandukanye rwose n'amafaranga y'ubukode, kandi nta na rimwe ifatwaho amafaranga y'urubuga.
howItWorks.fuelCardBody: Buri modoka ifite amabwiriza ya lisansi asobanutse: Iruzuye uyigarure yuzuye, Urwego rumwe, Tanki y'ubuntu, cyangwa Nyirayo ni we ubyishyura. Ayo mabwiriza agaragazwa neza ku rupapuro rw'imodoka n'urw'ubukode, nta gutungurwa.
howItWorks.pickupCardBody: Hitamo mu hantu hemejwe n'urubuga (ibibuga by'indege, hoteri), ahantu nyir'imodoka yihitiyemo, cyangwa usobanure aho uri. Amakarita ahora ari ubushake. Ntabwo agomba ku gahato.
howItWorks.o1Body: Tegura umwirondoro wa nyir'imodoka ushyiramo amazina na telefoni, hanyuma wongereho aho wishyurirwa. MTN MoMo cyangwa konti ya banki. Aho wishyurirwa harakenewe mbere y'uko wandikisha imodoka. Hanyuma uhitemo gahunda yawe: Basic, Pro cyangwa Premium.
howItWorks.o2Body: Ifishi y'intambwe 5 igutwara mu: amakuru y'ibanze, amafoto (3–10), ibiciro by'ibihe byose, kalendari y'iminsi iboneka, n'ahantu bafata imodoka. Bika nk'umushinga ugaruke igihe cyose. Umushinga wibikwa buri masegonda 60.
howItWorks.o3Body: Wakira SMS igihe ubusabe bwo gukodesha bugeze. Emera cyangwa wange mu masaha 2. Nutagira icyo usubiza, bwemezwa mu buryo bwikora (ni byiza ku kimenyetso cy'igihe usubiza). Shyiraho amabwiriza yawe yo guhagarika.
howItWorks.o4Body: Wowe n'umukodesha mwembi mushyiraho amafoto y'uko imodoka imeze mbere na nyuma ya buri rugendo. Hanze, imbere, n'igipimo cya lisansi. Amafoto abikwa iminsi 3 nyuma yo kurangiza, hanyuma agasibwa mu buryo bwikora.
howItWorks.o5Body: Urugendo rumaze kurangira, saba kwishyurwa uhereye ku ncamake yawe. Abashinzwe imari boherereza amafaranga kuri MoMo cyangwa banki mu masaha 24 kandi bagashyiraho icyemezo. Ukomeza kubona 80% ku buri bukode.
howItWorks.reviewsCardBody: Abakiliya barangije ubukode kuri iyo modoka nyayo ni bo bonyine bashobora gutanga igitekerezo. Amanota areba isuku, ubwuzu, agaciro, n'itumanaho rya nyir'imodoka.
howItWorks.disputeCardBody: Uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose rushobora gutanga impaka. Ikipe yacu isuzuma amafoto y'uko imodoka yari imeze n'inyandiko z'igipimo cya lisansi maze igakemura mu masaha 48. Ingwate ibikwa kugeza bikemutse.
howItWorks.photoCardBody: Amafoto yo mbere na nyuma y'urugendo arakenewe ku mpande zombi. Amafoto y'uko imodoka imeze abikwa iminsi 3 nyuma y'urugendo rwarangiye, cyangwa kugeza impaka zikemutse burundu.
